proof_body:
by
  intro n m
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · exact Polynomial.Chebyshev.intervalIntegrable_sqrt_one_sub_sq_inv.continuousOn_mul (by fun_prop)
  rw [← Polynomial.Chebyshev.integral_measureT (fun x => (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ n).eval x * (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ m).eval x)]
  split_ifs with h h0
  · exact Polynomial.Chebyshev.integral_eval_T_real_mul_eval_T_real_measureT_of_ne (by exact_mod_cast h)
  · subst h0
    push Not at h
    subst h
    simpa using Polynomial.Chebyshev.integral_eval_T_real_mul_self_measureT_zero
  · push Not at h
    subst h
    exact_mod_cast Polynomial.Chebyshev.integral_T_real_mul_self_measureT_of_ne_zero h0
target_source: ∀ n m : ℕ, IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ n).eval x * (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ m).eval x * Real.sqrt ((1 - x ^ 2)⁻¹)) MeasureTheory.volume (-1) 1 ∧ ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ n).eval x * (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ m).eval x * Real.sqrt ((1 - x ^ 2)⁻¹) = if n ≠ m then 0 else if n = 0 then Real.pi else Real.pi / 2
